usedFor: Buildkite runs CI/CD pipelines, and “Create YAML Pipeline” and “Update YAML Pipeline” keep them in step with your setup.

bestTemplate.name: “Create YAML Pipeline” in Buildkite
bestTemplate.why: It creates a YAML pipeline, so a new project gets its build pipeline without manual setup.

watchOut: “Delete Pipeline By Slug Name” deletes an existing pipeline, so check the name before it runs.
